item.title: Correction · The 2026-09-20 planned-since row for Mission Rock says Resolutions 25-05/25-06 "accepted" Phase 1's streets and paseos and approved a paseo-management agreement with Mission Rock Commons, and that Bridgeview Street and the Shared Public Way are "already complete". Port Commission minutes, 2025-02-11, item 12A: "authorize Port staff to accept public infrastructure and improvements including streets, sidewalks, parks, and open spaces constructed by Seawall 337, LLC"; "Resolutions 25-05 and Resolution 25-06 passed unanimously"; staff: "We will then go to the Board of Supervisors to finish the acceptance process"; "Mission Rock Commons will be the name of that" (the park lessee, which also takes over the paseos management agreement). The minutes do not name Bridgeview Street or the Shared Public Way.
